  3. <fidel-job-card>

<fidel-job-card>

Job card. A job advert from a Fidel server: employer, place, closing date in both calendars, accommodations, and a summary to read or listen to.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Disabled job seekers (workplace accommodations in words), learners who find reading hard (Listen), and search engines (schema.org JobPosting).

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Looking for a job on this server…

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-job-card job="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/api/v1/jobs/JOB_ID" lang="en"></fidel-job-card>

Source: player/src/job-card.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-job-card>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
jobURLnoneA job on a Fidel server (/api/v1/jobs/ID).
langen, amthe page's lang, else enInterface language.
heading-level2 to 63Level of the component's heading, so it fits your page's outline.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-job-card>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-job-ready{ id, title }The job is shown.
fidel-summary-play{ lang }The learner played the summary.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Listen to summary" is a button; Stop stops it.
  • English uses a recording or the browser's voice; Amharic needs a recording, so there is no Amharic button without one.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Interface in English or Amharic (lang). The closing date is in both calendars, e.g. 30 Nov 2026 / ህዳር 21 2019.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: A heading and a description list.
  • 1.4.10 Reflow: No sideways scrolling at 320 px.
  • It also puts the job as schema.org/JobPosting JSON-LD on the page.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
